name: Sarukawa Kinjirou
source:
A friend of the protagonist, and Masato's childhood friend.

He's the head of the mysterious Boy's club (The club is not approved officially), but even he doesn't know what the club does.

Although he enrolled in Ousui to form a harem, it isn't working out; he's having difficulties reconciling his fantasies and reality.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171025215447/https://sekaiproject.com/products/wagamama-high-spec/]Sekai Project[/url]]
